# Metrics fixtures (placeholders)

These JPEGs are **synthetic placeholders** generated by `tests/generate_fixtures.py` so CI/unit tests can run before real night-sky photos are available.

| File | Intent |
|------|--------|
| `sharp_orion.jpg` | Dark sky + sharp star dots |
| `blurry_phone.jpg` | Same field, blurred (lower sharpness) |
| `daytime_cat.jpg` | Bright non-sky → `is_night_sky` false |

**Ben:** replace these with real captures when ready; keep the filenames.
